title: Extrusion Operator
description:
Mier Temporary Staffing is hiring!

Job Title: Extrusion Operator
Location: Peel Region, ON
Salary: $21.00-$24.00/hour
Shift: Monday to Friday 7:00 am - 3:00 pm 

Our Client in Peel Region is looking for a Extrusion Operator to join their team.

Job Responsibilities:
  • Two years' experience in a 24-hour industrial environment is required
  • Experience in thermoplastic extrusion is appreciated
  • Manufacturing environment, Production Line and Machine Operator
  • Set up machinery and ensure all materials are readily available
  • Prepare, starts, runs and stop the extrusion line (Machine)
  • Follow-up key product properties and reacts accordingly.
  • Record production parameters and ensures a proper traceability of the product
  • Feed the line with raw materials
  • Unload and store welded blocks
  • Adjust the line parameter in order to achieve high quality level and low scrap rates.
  • Relieve and assist the supervisor in his responsibilities.
  • Ensure quality standards are met. Visually inspect parts and dispose of non-spec parts.
  • Report any machine or product quality concerns to supervisor.
  • Assist in the training of other workers.
  • Contribute to keep the working area clean and safe.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the line
  • Perform all other related assignments as management directs
Qualifications:
  • Technical background (mechanical and/or plastics) is appreciated
  • Ability to understand orders written or orally given in English.
  • Physical ability to lift on a regular and on- going basis up to forty (40) pounds.
  • Medical fitness to perform all the essential duties of the position.
  • Ability to organize efficiently to manage several tasks
  • Ability to read and understand numbers, and to undertake basic mathematics (i.e., addition, multiplication etc.) and the ability to communicate those numbers.

If you meet the above qualifications, please submit your resume. Please note that while we appreciate all applications, only those being considered will be contacted.

title: Cost Analyst
description:
Accountivity is hiring!

  • Assist with financial budget preparation for the Toronto facility
  • Administer bills of material, routings, and costed BOMs
  • Administer daily cycle count adjustments
  • Assist and later lead the annual physical inventory, including planning, execution, and variance analysis for finished goods, raw materials, and WIP
  • Lead, facilitate, or participate in CI projects
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement
Skills & Qualifications:
  • University degree in Accounting (CPA designation an asset)
  • 3–5 years of cost analysis experience in a manufacturing environment
  • Strong computer skills with intermediate/advanced Excel proficiency
  • Experience in an MRP environment
